# Noctua 4-pin PWM Y-cable (included with the NF-A20 PWM)

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

| | |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `noctua-4pin-y-cable` |
| Category | purchased |
| Product | <https://www.noctua.at/en/products/nf-a20-pwm> |

One comes in every NF-A20 PWM box (see noctua-nf-a20-pwm). Splits one 4-pin PWM
header to two fans: both get 12 V and the PWM signal, but only one branch carries its
fan's speed signal back to the controller, as on Y-cables generally (unverified for
this cable). Chain three to run four fans from one header.
